_meta.purpose: Master dataset for HK population / migration accounting, cross-referencing C&SD, IMMD, HKIA, LegCo sources, to validate or replace atseed.co/hkborder's airport-net-flow methodology
_meta.atseed_co_metric_label: IMMD HK-Resident Airport Net Out — short-trip-noise-dominated; NOT equal to OtherNetMigration

sources.AD_2024: C&SD Hong Kong Annual Digest of Statistics 2024, Table 1.1 + 1.12 (revised, includes foreign domestic helpers, published Sep 2024)
sources.ISSF01_LegCo: LegCo Research Office 'Hong Kong in figures' monthly series (each issue cites C&SD)
sources.FS05_2022: LegCo Research Office Fact Sheet on talent attraction policies (Oct 2022)
sources.ISSH23_2024: LegCo Statistical Highlight on talent admission schemes (Oct 2024)
sources.RT01_2025: LegCo Research Topic on talent inflow policies (Feb 2025)
sources.ISSH33_2024: LegCo Statistical Highlight on HK residents in the Mainland (Dec 2024)
sources.ISSH10_2025: LegCo Statistical Highlight on cross-border elderly welfare (May 2025)
sources.IN15_2025: LegCo Information Note on UK/Canada healthcare eligibility (Aug 2025)
sources.IMMD_CSV: IMMD daily passenger traffic CSV (atseed.co's source)
sources.HKIA_API: hongkongairport.com flight info REST API (rolling 91-day window)
sources.CAD_Stat: Civil Aviation Department air traffic statistics workbook (Stat Webpage.xlsx)

midyear_population._note: AD 2024 = latest revised series, includes foreign domestic helpers (~340K). ISSF figures are LegCo summaries citing same C&SD source.

2022.source: AD_2024 (revised). FS05/2022 original published 7,291,600 excluding maids.

2024.note: Earlier ISSF01/2025 Jan reported 7,531,800 — revised down -7,700

2025.note: Mid-year 2025 — vital component breakdown pending AD 2025 (due ~Sep 2026)

yearend_population._note: Year-end estimates (different from mid-year), reported in ISSF01/2026 latest issues

2024.note: Births up vs 2023 (talent scheme baby boom?); deaths drop

one_way_permit_arrivals._note: Daily quota 150. Inflow of Mainland Chinese settling in HK via OWP

derived_net_movement._formula: NetMovement_y = MidPop_y - MidPop_(y-1) - NaturalChange_y. OtherNet_y = NetMovement_y - OWP_y
derived_net_movement._source: Derived from C&SD AD 2024 Tables 1.1 + 1.12 (no independent source; recomputable from midyear_population, vital_statistics, one_way_permit_arrivals)
derived_net_movement._note: Computed from AD_2024 series. 'OtherNet' is the actual emigration/immigration channel atseed.co attempts to proxy.

2024._note: ΔPop − NatChg = -12,000 − (-15,670) = +3,670 net inflow. OWP 2024 not yet officially published; await AD 2025 (Sep 2026).

2025._note: 2024→2025 mid-year delta from ISSF01/2025 Dec; vital + OWP components pending

cumulative_2020_2025_partial._note: Population basically flat across 6 years; components for 2024-2025 incomplete

atseed_co_airport_net._note: atseed.co metric: HK-Resident airport departures minus arrivals, from IMMD daily CSV. THIS IS GROSS SHORT-TRIP MOVEMENT, NOT NET MIGRATION.
atseed_co_airport_net._source: computed from IMMD opendata CSV (HK Residents only at Airport control point)

talent_admission_schemes_approved._note: Visa approvals — not all approved persons actually arrive. ISSH23/2024 Figure 3 + RT01/2025 cumulative.

top_talent_pass_cumulative_to_2024_end.note: RT01/2025 §1.1. Most arrivals from mainland China. Economic contribution est. HK$34B/year ≈ 1.2% of GDP.

top_talent_pass_cumulative_to_2024_end_r._source: Hong Kong SAR Government LegCo Q&A 2025-01-22 (P2025012200216), Labour & Welfare Bureau Secretary Sun Yuk-han

source_composition_2023.note: vs 2019: mainland 36.7% / other 63.3% — major shift toward Mainland-sourced talent

hk_residents_in_mainland._note: ISSH33/2024 cites 2020 census + C&SD 'usual stay' alternate methodology

guangdong_usual_stay._note: Stayed >=6 months in Guangdong within 1-year window of reference. Includes frequent cross-border travelers.

guangdong_scheme_welfare_recipients._note: Public Welfare Allowance recipients living in Guangdong

emigration_to_anglosphere._note: From destination-country immigration records (UK Home Office BN(O) + Canadian PR HK-pathway + Australian Hong Kong stream)

uk_bno_visa_granted_2021_01_to_2025_03.source: UK Home Office, via UK Data Service Blog (2025-07-30) — https://blog.ukdataservice.ac.uk/bno-migrants-panel-survey/
uk_bno_visa_granted_2021_01_to_2025_03.note: Approximate; blog cites Home Office as 'almost 180,000 granted between January 2021 and March 2025'

canada_hk_pathway_to_2025_08_31._source: IRCC reply to House of Commons written question Q-493 (Sessional Paper 8555-451-493), Minister Peter Fragiskatos, 2025-12-05 — https://www.ourcommons.ca/written-questions/45-1/q-493

good_conduct_certificate_applications._note: Security Bureau 'Certificate of No Criminal Conviction' — proxy for emigration intent, used in historical analyses

stock_hk_born_in_anglo_2021._source: Australian Bureau of Statistics + ONS + Statistics Canada via IN15/2025

hkia_flight_destination_mix_91day_proxy._caveat: Operation count != passenger count. Mainland routes use smaller aircraft (A320 ~180 seats) vs intercontinental (A350 ~300+). Mainland passenger share probably 15-18%, lower than 24% op share.

cad_civil_international_air_transport._source: CAD Civil Aviation Department, Stat Webpage.xlsx (in data/legco_sources/CAD_air_traffic_1998_2026.xlsx)
cad_civil_international_air_transport._note: CAD Stat Webpage.xlsx — all-port passenger totals (residents + visitors, all directions)
